cost: Costs sum repeated resolver and scorer calls: two singleton policies × six systems plus FULL.len+1 cumulative runs plus diagnostics and strip-control reruns. Scoring delegates matching and assignment matrix costs. Error rows capped400 per diagnostic run; report/output buffers and per-document predictions retained.

forward: gold_of groups first-seen eid and sets anaphoric iff mention key differs from entity minimum (sent,start,-end). visible excludes internal and singleton coordination absent coord-sgl substring override. sys_entities recomputes span heads; out_mentions preserves mention heads, numbers nonempty visible clusters from1 and notes last link/new/sgl. score_all adds score_doc Counts over zip, not average F1. run gold parses/self-checks then verifies document counts, appends baseline/cumulative reports, writes errors, checks strip invariance, optionally writes CoNLL-U.
inverse: Given output entities, compatible Sys states may differ in filtered internal mentions, singleton groups, explanations and original heads (sys_entities recomputes them). A metric row admits many gold/pred partitions with identical aggregate counts. Serialized notes constrain last from-link but not complete history.
